_about: Crissa's own voice. Created with Grok: every sound in this clip was generated by Grok Imagine (xAI) as the soundtrack of two of Crissa's films; nothing in it is a recording of a person. It is her reference clip for the voices that clone (Chatterbox-Turbo, Chatterbox Multilingual, Audio8). Covered by MEDIA-LICENSE.md like her films: you may use it to run Crissa on devices you control, not to clone her voice for anything else.
transcript: Hey, I just wanted to share something quick. So I was thinking about redecorating this space, and maybe we could use the hallway for extra storage.
made_from: The two films' soundtracks joined (12.03 s), with 0.45 s of silence cut from the start and a 2.40 s pause cut from the middle (12.03 - 2.85 = 9.18 s). No other change: every one-second window of the clip matches the films' sound at correlation 0.9998 or better (checked 2026-10-08).

status_why: Both originals are Grok Imagine outputs saved by the Grok app's image-to-video tool (an API download), which carry no Signature comment tag; see FILM-PROVENANCE.json's _about.

sources.prompt: She sits facing the camera and speaks a short line, mouth clearly forming words. Her head rides small natural syllable nods. The high loose bun wobbles and lags a beat behind each nod, soft strands drifting. Locked camera, indoor room light.
